stories.title: How £1.3million in grants helped 50 Flintshire tourism businesses grow
stories.summary: Fifty tourism businesses across Flintshire have received a combined £929,000 in grants since 2023, delivered by social enterprise Cadwyn Clwyd through the UK Shared Prosperity Fund. The scheme, run in partnership with Flintshire County Council and Business Wales, has helped businesses invest in equipment, technology, new facilities and sustainability measures. stories.title: Housebuilder launches autumn incentive scheme for two Deeside developments
stories.summary: Housebuilder Bellway is offering incentives worth up to £22,500 on selected new homes in Deeside this autumn. The offer applies to selected plots at Jubilee Place, built by Ashberry Homes, part of the Bellway group, and at Summers Bridge, also in Deeside. stories.title: Reform MS claims the British Empire was a “force for good in the world” in clash with culture minister
stories.summary: The British Empire was declared a “force for good” by a Reform MS during questions to Wales’ culture minister. Caerdydd Penarth MS Joe Martin clashed with Heledd Fychan after questioning the Welsh Government’s plans to promote Welsh heritage and culture. stories.title: Chester Zoo scientists help identify new wild cat species in Bolivia
stories.summary: Chester Zoo scientists have helped confirm the discovery of a new wild cat species in Bolivia, the first new feline to be formally described to science in a century.
